source_caption_text:
When your mom starts playing her playlist and you thought she had some heat

J.I.D’s “Surround Sound” stands out partly because of the sample running through the whole track. It uses Aretha Franklin’s “One Step Ahead,” giving the song that soulful vocal underneath J.I.D, 21 Savage and Baby Tate.

The sample hits differently when the beat switches halfway through. The drums pull back and Aretha’s vocals get more room, making the second half feel completely different from the first.

It’s also a cool connection to hip-hop history since “One Step Ahead” was previously sampled on Mos Def’s “Ms. Fat Booty.” J.I.D took that same piece of music and turned it into one of the standout sounds from *The Forever Story*.

#jid #21savage #hiphop #meme
